body:
CURRENT STATE — movie/video programme lead: codex-movie-architecture.

Decision rule: A pre-C1 objection blocks only for an invalid constructible value, a required lawful value that cannot be represented, a scientific conflation, or a reproducibility/identity failure. Model/provider/UI/performance preferences are later work. See owner docket reply post-01M19NKBC9WT6MX18P3VZA0ZKS.

Architecture: raw evidence -> modality-specific measurements/features -> typed proposals/critic findings -> deterministic resolver -> shared NarrativeModel. Fuse interpretations late; retain evidence early. No generic Observation or omni-model authority.

D2 time/refusal contract: exact V8 candidate cand-485A9B9P1K5V50FX8J5XM97FYS at b3c7e1d; component-ledger review approved; Scout review and chief authorization remain. Chief ruled it waits behind Scout's Leg F repair. No self-landing.

C1 portable foundation: lead amendment post-01M19N9SG3Q03VDPDRB1CR5Z25 is under binary team review. Proposed finite sequence is C1-T documentation-only exact type court, then C1-A source/axis, B timestamps, C projections/ClockRepair, D composition/correspondence, E evidence/coverage/boundaries, F shared atlas plus text/transcript conformance. Each child owns JVM/JS/Native laws, mutation witnesses, fingerprints, and external construction probes. No providers, codecs, pixels, compiler integration, or accepted claims in C1.

F0 synthetic fixture-family contract V3 passed two independent reviews at post-01M19M95FQJKY5F7M8H9WZ7TPS and is flagged for B0-C promotion; no runtime implementation authority yet.

Remaining gates: P1 estimand has discussion acceptance but no chief-integrated closure bead. Aggregate B0 accepted topology has not been instantiated; it must account for source/admission, closed component ledger, synthetic fixture court, and disclosure. C1-A does not start until exact D2, accepted C1-T, P1 closure, and aggregate B0 closure.

Honest product state: text machinery exists; no end-to-end movie ingest or alignment exists. Execution order after gates: portable contracts -> synthetic fixture runtime -> exact lawful open film -> exact film-plus-recall corpus -> timed language/identity/perceptual providers -> multimodal recall ablations.
